record_identity_analysis.interpretation: RowNumber can at most identify a row within this observed snapshot if uniqueness and sequence checks pass. A positional row number is not evidence of a durable source identifier across refreshed or reordered source exports. Exact row fingerprints are diagnostics, not guaranteed stable IDs.

category_skill_expansion.interpretation: The all-category figure is a cross-product scenario, not a recommendation. Repeating each post skill for every category can inflate counts and must not be treated as independent skill demand without an explicit attribution rule.
